 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA  ORAL ORDER 2 09-07-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioners apprehend arrests in connection with Asarganj PS Case No. 27 of 2025 dated 11-02-2025, instituted under Section 376,323,120B of the IPC and Section 4/6 of the POCSO Act .
3. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2, both under speed post with A.D. as well as ordinary process for which requisites etc., must be filed within one week from today.
As also, let a legible Xerox copy of the case diary of Asarganj PS Case No. 27 of 2025 be called for from the Court of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41531 of 2025(2) dt.09-07-2025
Spl. Judge (POCSO)-cum- District and Additional Sessions Judge VI, Munger, so as to reach this Court positively within a period of three weeks.
